items.name: dsh-codebase-memory

items.name: dsh-devforge

items.name: code-rag#dsh-code-rag-index-panel

items.name: dsh-substrate#plugin

items.name: dsh-plugin-preflight

items.name: dsh-backup-sync

items.name: dsh-conflict-guardian

items.name: my-dsh-plugins#dsh-file-activity
items.desc: DSH sidebar file-activity tab: records file reads/creates/modifies by the agent and the sidebar (including file ops hidden inside bash commands), per-session isolation, survives restarts, click a file for a floating preview (npm: `dsh-file-activity`).

items.name: my-dsh-plugins#dsh-my-guardian
items.desc: Plugin governance: new/updated plugins stage in a candidate area first, then hot-mount after startup — success promotes, failure auto-disables, repeated failures freeze, one-click safe mode, sidebar diagnostics panel (npm: `dsh-my-guardian`).

items.name: my-dsh-plugins#dsh-my-observability

items.name: dsh-write-create-only

items.name: dsh-write-rule-guard

items.name: dsh-one-click-restart

items.desc: Network proxy manager for DeepSeek Harness: switch between system, manual, and direct modes from a live settings UI, applied instantly.

items.name: dsh-loop-engine
items.desc: A web Settings "Loop engine" switch that swaps the agent loop driving every dsh session among five engines — the built-in in-process loop plus hosted Claude Code, Codex, Pi, and Kimi Code — with zero changes to the harness; each hosted engine keeps its thinking and tool calls in the durable session transcript, takes over commands, skills, and the agent preset, and runs sandboxed through the dsh subprocess seam.

items.name: dsh-fail-soft
items.desc: Automatically disables a failing plugin so the rest of DSH keeps booting — by patching DSH’s own installed kernel (mount-time quarantine + self-healing), not preflight smoke-tests. Includes status tools and a one-click restore panel.

items.name: dsh-plugin-compat-check#plugin
items.desc: Checks installed DSH plugins for version-declaration and API risks against the current host, with source locations when available, certainty, impact basis and coverage limits. Adds a compatibility settings panel, plugin-detail findings/badges, a compat_check agent tool and a skill provider.

items.name: dsh-agent-arena
items.desc: Compares coding agents in isolated Git worktrees with deterministic validation, scoring, and explicit winner application.

items.name: dsh-ssh
items.desc: SSH profiles, browser terminals, SFTP browsing, port forwarding, proxies, and session-scoped AI access for DeepSeek Harness.

items.name: dsh-composition-doctor
items.desc: Explain supported DSH plugin failures with composition source paths and manual next steps: duplicate insertions, missing bundle patches and peer mismatches; standalone CLI and report viewer, read-only diagnosis offline by default, with unobserved runtime left unknown.

items.name: dsh-lint-loop
items.desc: Change-aware quality loop for DSH: fast lint feedback and safe regression-only repair, bounded completion checks for lint deltas, TypeScript and impacted Vitest/Jest tests, and a Quality Receipt that separates new regressions from historical debt.

items.name: dsh-api-probe
items.desc: Diagnoses third-party LLM API endpoints from the sidebar: a four-layer check (DNS/TCP/TLS, key and model, a real streaming conversation, then timed repeat runs) reporting time-to-first-token, output speed and success rate, with every failure attributed to the step it stalled at and the byte count that actually left the machine. 37 provider presets, no model names hardcoded.

items.name: dsh-workspace-api
items.desc: Exposes the DSH workspace as an HTTP API: browse, search and read files, and run natural-language agent tasks that answer with cited sources.

items.name: dsh-api
items.desc: Exposes dsh's internal capabilities (language, workspace registry, agent-status and approval events) over HTTP under /dsh-api on the local loopback socket dsh already listens on, with SSE fan-out at /dsh-api/events.

items.name: crash-guard-dsh
items.desc: Crash protection plugin that auto-isolates plugins causing startup crash or hang, with independent watchdog process for total hang recovery.

items.name: godot-asset-planner-public
items.desc: Unified Godot asset and project-goal management for DSH: godot_* model tools, a /gap REST surface, and a better-sidebar UI with asset manager, scene-tree viewer, and Git panel.

items.name: dsh-devpanel
items.desc: A developer toolkit for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web console: a real multi-tab PTY terminal docked under the composer plus an AI-output file browser sidebar with syntax highlighting, Markdown rendering and image preview.

items.name: dsh-trace-insight#standard
items.desc: Read-only trajectory review in a resizable conversation sidebar, with rule analysis, optional model explanations, evidence navigation, and same-range run comparison.

items.name: dsh-hot-refresh
items.desc: Panel entry for the official client-plugin hot reload that tells you what actually changed first: it diffs each row rev against the last seen state and reloads only the plugin bundles that changed, keeps whole-graph reloads behind an explicit confirmation (a bare call is refused and reports the affected row count), and reports replay counters so a silent no-op cannot hide.

items.name: dsh-compat-vet
items.desc: Plugin compatibility vet for dsh that compares installed plugins peerDependencies against the running dsh version to flag which ones the startup preflight will refuse to load, prints copy-pasteable fix commands, and offers a top-of-page banner in dsh web to isolate, uninstall or upgrade them, with an automatic backup before the change and rollback if the re-check fails.

items.name: yihe-packs-dsh
items.desc: YiHe pkg-dev knowledge packs for DeepSeek Harness: 52 domain packs and 90 RFB experience files for coding cognition.

items.name: dshessentialtools
items.desc: A permanent DSH plugin that bundles a developer workbench, an in-session conversation tree, and a plugin manager: build and run an LVAL project, browse its code, and keep per-program version snapshots with rollback; edit, retry, or branch any message in place, with message micro-versions; a feature manager plus a global-plugin library whose entries each carry an enable tier; cross-dialogue memory, one-shot temporary chats, and model collaboration; five network-permission tiers, mixed-model routing, a security audit, and browser control through a companion extension.

items.name: dsh-injection-guard
items.desc: Source-aware prompt injection guard for DSH: tracks untrusted turn context, detects injection signals, scores sensitive sinks, and blocks high-risk tool calls with explainable audit logs.

items.name: dsh-apirevise
items.desc: API regression and acceptance workbench: snapshot the responses of the endpoints you register before the agent edits the backend, rerun them all after the edit, and review a structured field-level diff (status codes, added and removed fields, numeric old → new values with the delta) beside the captured source diff, accepting each endpoint one by one before exporting a Markdown or single-file HTML report.

items.name: dsh-reload
items.desc: Reload a plugin or skill you just installed without restarting DSH. reload_plugin clears that plugin's own module cache, unloads the old instance and re-imports it, restoring the previous module if the new code throws; reload_skill forces skill directories to be re-discovered. Ships both as tools and as the /reload-plugin and /reload-skill commands.

items.name: dsh-workbench-agent-studio
items.desc: Agent Studio for DSH Web: configure models, prompts, per-plugin tool bindings and Skills; trial-run with editable tool results and run history; preserve session capability snapshots; export standalone presets; draft Agents with a guided creator preset.

items.name: dsh-desktop-restart
items.desc: Restart the whole DeepSeek Harness desktop app from five entry points (sidebar panel, sidebar footer, conversation title bar, /restart-desktop slash command, settings row) through a detached helper that ends and relaunches the Electron main process, instead of only restarting the dsh web process. It hard-blocks a restart while a plugin install/update is running and pnpm is still alive, sweeps the change snapshots DSH leaves behind in the system temp directory, and hides the easy-to-misclick feedback item in the account menu. Desktop only; on dsh web the status route reports desktop: false and the button is disabled.

items.name: dsh-app-packager#dsh-app-packager
items.desc: Packaging pipeline for uni-app x projects: reads the local HBuilderX version, recommends and one-click installs the matching iOS / Android / HarmonyOS offline SDK (panel card with official download links), then drives the HBuilderX CLI to build, sign and upload apps from per-project config files; the engine also ships as list / doctor / check / build tools for the agent.

items.name: agents-plugins#dsh-service-control
items.desc: Manage the dsh service via `dsh --profile ctl`: systemd lifecycle (install, start, stop, restart, enable, disable, uninstall), persisted config, health probe and logs, plus shell completions and self-update.

items.name: dsh-quick-reload
items.desc: One-click page refresh for the DSH Web UI: purges the rebuildable caches (Cache Storage, service workers, /plugins/** bundle bytes) and reloads the page, so a hot-injected client plugin appears without restarting the app.

items.name: dsh-project-panel
items.desc: Low-code project workspace for the DSH web UI. A multi-level file tree with a push-status ledger, in-panel source view and edit, pre-push static checks, and a scaffold for an empty workspace. Requires the MagicalCoder platform and a server profile (address + designer account) for push/pull.

items.name: dsh-autostart
items.desc: Windows boot autostart and one-click restart for the DSH service, from inside DSH: a resident supervisor that outlives the host, so a failed restart cannot leave DSH down; DSH spawned attached to a hidden console the supervisor owns, so no console window appears; plus a restart button, the current tokenised access URL and an optional post-start hook.

items.name: dsh-power
items.desc: Floating power dock for the DSH web GUI: one-click restart or graceful shutdown of the dsh host, loopback-guarded and dependency-free.

items.name: dsh-farm
items.desc: Service farm for DSH: register, start, stop and restart long-running project services, with agent tools (farm_status/start/stop/restart/logs/register), farm.yaml declarations and an overview drawer UI with live log follow, search and export.

items.name: dsh-sentry
items.desc: Read-only Sentry tools: project listing, issue search at organization or project scope, single issue detail, and the latest or a specific event with a trimmed stacktrace. Local variables, request headers and bodies, query strings, packages and secret-looking tags are removed before the event reaches the model, and oversized events degrade through source context, breadcrumbs and frames rather than failing.

items.name: dsh-webui-studio
items.desc: Visual development studio for DSH WebUI plugins with isolated Git worktrees, live official-WebUI previews, source editing, patch inspection, builds, and validation.

items.name: dsh-rtk-rewrite
items.desc: Replaces the web profile's pwsh shell executor with a subclass that rewrites every command through `rtk rewrite` before execution for token savings, running the original command unchanged on any rewrite failure (no equivalent, missing rtk, timeout) and keeping sandbox semantics intact.

items.name: dsh-simplify
items.desc: Adds a /simplify command that asks the agent to simplify code within a selected Git change scope, including staged changes, commits, and untracked files.

items.name: dsh-thinking-zh
items.desc: Registers system-prompt sections that make the model reason in Simplified or Traditional Chinese, with strict/prefer modes and an optional reply-language policy. Adds a /thinking-zh command for per-session switching. Zero runtime dependencies.

items.name: forge#forge-dsh
items.desc: Forge quality gates for DeepSeek Harness: task gates, read-before-edit, bash hazard interception and quality scoring, enforced by the local forge CLI through DSH's typed interception points. Requires the forge CLI on PATH; without it the plugin fails open and says so with a best-effort notice at session start, and task gates also need forge init in the project.

items.name: dsh-forge
items.desc: Plugin-combination analysis for the DeepSeek Harness: dependency trees, conflict detection, risk scoring with prediction, visualization, and combination simulation.

items.name: dsh-live-reload
items.desc: Hot-reloads DSH plugin modules without restarting the app (module-cache purge, junction-path matching, bust fallback) and registers a refresh button in the session header so the browser page loads the new plugin bundles.

items.name: dsh-pouch#dsh-plugin-restart
items.desc: Safe detached DSH restart: /restart and /dsh-restart slash commands with native candidate styling plus a dsh_restart agent tool; a detached worker restarts DSH after 3 seconds without freezing the session.

items.name: dsh-deveco
items.desc: HarmonyOS development suite for DSH: a right-sidebar HiLog inspector (live stream with level/logger/text filters) and an ArkUI Inspector (screenshot pick, collapsible component tree, node properties with search, box model), two tree sources — the DevEco debug channel (declared padding/margin/border and custom component names) and the uitest accessibility tree — an .ets viewer with ArkTS syntax highlighting, DevEco Studio/CLT toolchain and device management, plus the harmony_ui_tree agent tool. 21 remote methods, 82 unit tests.

items.name: dsh-restart-now
items.desc: One-click full-app restart for the DSH desktop client: a sidebar footer button and a settings section with a live config form (master switch, confirm dialog, delay, target executable). Restart is performed by a detached helper that survives the process-tree kill, then respawns DeepSeek Harness.exe; requests are fenced to loopback same-origin.

items.name: dsh-image-webp-to-png
items.desc: Re-encodes WebP attachment images to PNG so alpha-channel images load on LLM backends that cannot decode WebP (e.g. llama.cpp).

items.name: dsh-k8s
items.desc: Multi-cluster Kubernetes management panel powered by local kubectl, with resource filtering, YAML editing, live Pod logs, interactive container terminals, workload restart/scaling, and DSH theme synchronization; accessible from the sidebar or session view. Requires DSH 0.2.0-rc.2.

items.name: dsh-ptc-plus
items.desc: Session-bound persistent TypeScript REPL for DSH PTC mode: bindings and imports stay live across run_code calls, edit_run_code replaces one line without resending the block, module import/export syntax is adapted via AST rewriting, and durable bindings are restored from the session journal after a cold restart.

items.name: cadence-skill
items.desc: Cadence SKILL (Virtuoso Lisp) assistant for EDA engineers: official-doc-anchored API lookup (3557 entries across 5 IC6.1.8 manuals, signature confidence levels, never invents APIs) plus zero-execution static analysis driven by a lexical depth coordinate system — iterator-safe deletion with position-sensitive copy() protection, printf placeholder/argument reconciliation, in-loop nth O(N^2) detection, deprecated APIs with page refs, dangerous-intent interception and CIW error-log triage. Host half has zero third-party dependencies.

items.name: dsh-plugin#dsh-maintain
items.desc: Version and maintenance suite for DSH itself: detects new host releases from npm dist-tags, upgrades with one click, restarts safely, and the web page auto-recovers once the host is back.

items.name: dsh-home-hosted
items.desc: Starts your dsh web and other servers at boot, sets up and manages services like Gitea and Jellyfin just by asking, and puts them all under one home-hosted panel.

items.name: dsh-rules
items.desc: Discovers rule files from every convention OMP supports and injects them into the system prompt as an always-apply layer plus a rulebook index, then enforces them with time-traveling stream rules that abort violating output mid-turn, deny a matching tool call, fold a reminder into that call's result, or ask a judge model about the finished reply. The same tool lets the model write new rules, and an audit panel on the Plugins page says why each rule is in force.

items.name: dsh-agent-log
items.desc: Read-only work report rebuilt from local session logs: tools used and how often, commands run, files read and written, whether tests passed, failures and their causes, token usage, and whether the task finished.

items.name: galfree
items.desc: Ren'Py galgame production workbench: a host-side project service (write gateway plus git snapshots, a dialogue/scene dialect parser, derived progress, human-only review stamps, pinned-SDK validation and playtest, local publish) behind one seam, driven by an embedded web panel and agent tools.

items.name: dsh-auto-approver
items.desc: Auto-approval agent for DSH permission requests: rule layer (denyAlways/allowlist) plus Hermes Pro semantic adjudication with quick-fail retries, fail-closed to human when Hermes is unavailable, rejection feedback returned to the requesting session, and approve tasks enqueued into the task queue with a shared busy mutex.

items.name: dsh-design-review
items.desc: Mandatory cross-review for design proposals and lessons-learned: auto-detects design doc writes and enqueues them (tier=review) into the task queue, delivers the external reviewer verdict back to the initiating session, and appends approved preventive measures to OPS-GUARDRAILS.md (append-only, conflict-checked).

items.name: dsh-reset-handoff
items.desc: Hands DSH reset requests to an external ops agent via a versioned JSON protocol: preflight snapshot, pre-restart maturity gate (no pending approvals, free disk, cooldown), restart, health check, and interrupted-work recovery, with the result delivered back to the requesting session.

items.name: dsh-task-queue
items.desc: Tiered task queue as the single source of truth for DSH↔Hermes work (reset > approve > review): enqueue tools for all submission paths, lease/claim model with concurrency 1, priority aging against starvation, atomic busy mutex, and a Hermes-side consumer (cron */1 + monitor gating) that drains tasks, writes review-handoff requests with single-slot checks, and invokes the reset agent.

items.name: dsh-bat2exe
items.desc: Compiles a Windows .bat/.cmd launcher into a real .exe from inside DSH: renders an icon from a built-in bitmap font, emits a C# wrapper that runs the batch file next to it, compiles with csc.exe (or dotnet build), and can write Start Menu / Desktop shortcuts.

items.name: dsh-autoupdater
items.desc: Scheduled update checks for DeepSeek Harness itself and installed plugins, applied only in idle windows — four schedule modes (daily, every N hours/days/minutes), bidirectional plugin whitelist, disk-verified installs, and a web settings panel with hot-reload config.

items.name: dsh-tray
items.desc: Windows system-tray launcher for DeepSeek Harness Web: start, stop, restart, open the Web UI, tail logs, live status icon, and a launch-at-login toggle.

items.name: dsh-plugin-deploy
items.desc: Ship a project to Cloudflare and publish your plugin to npm — the first deploy needs no cloud account, and credentials never reach the model.

items.name: dsh-harness-trace
items.desc: Records every session as one readable Markdown timeline inside the session workspace - the full request sent to the model (system prompt and plugin injections included), user input, replies, reasoning, tool calls and results, file reads and writes, web searches, skill loads, command runs and token usage - with a review page, a per-session tab and configurable capture scope.

items.name: stent
items.desc: An MC-Fabric-style hook processor.

items.name: dsh-claude-plugin-loader
items.desc: Loads Claude-style plugins into DeepSeek Harness (dsh): discovers skills, commands and optional SessionStart hooks from Claude plugin directories, with hot command reload and uninstall cleanup.

items.name: stalegreen#dsh-plugin-stalegreen
items.desc: Freshness gate for the agent's test, typecheck, lint and build claims: each verification run becomes a receipt on tools/post-execute, file edits are tracked, and on agent/turn-stopping a claim whose latest receipt is stale, failed or has no readable result steers one more step naming the receipt and the files edited since.

items.name: dsh-cert-mcp
items.desc: Read-only MCP server over the DSH plugin-certification registry, exposing a plugin certification grade, its snapshot and the five-dimension evidence behind it.

items.name: dsh-fast
items.desc: Performance profiling and LLM cache diagnostics for DeepSeek Harness — context engineering, latency profiling, and cache behavior reports.

items.name: dsh-plugin-doctor
items.desc: Zero-dependency static and sandbox smoke detector for DSH plugins: package-structure gates, cordis contract scans, keyless headless smoke, and ecosystem-listing checks.

items.name: dsh-plugin-kit
items.desc: Shared toolkit for authoring DeepSeek Harness plugins, published as @perrylink/dsh-plugin-kit: a pluggable provider registry seam, fail-closed approval and session-event gates, shared sanitize/pricing/judge modules and a new-plugin skeleton.

items.name: dsh-score
items.desc: Multi-dimensional quality scoring for DeepSeek Harness plugins that scores a repo or npm package across install success, maintenance activity, documentation completeness, security scan, and protocol compliance using real CLI evidence, and produces a JSON or Markdown leaderboard report.

items.name: better-dsh#better-dsh
items.desc: Make your dsh ready for serious coding. (Tools x Schemas)^REPL. `skill://`, `ctx://`, `agent://`, `dvc://`, `dsh://`, IPython REPL, Context as Variables, cross compactions recallable, full context revive. `hash-edit`, `dvc://browser`, subagent as function, workflow as function.

items.name: dsh-context-verdict
items.desc: Session-level verdict on whether compaction would lose unlanded state; structurally refuses per-block screening.

items.name: dsh-fuhuobi
items.desc: Backs up DSH profiles and mints a desktop "revival coin" that restores the harness after a failed boot or install: a boot guard runs a two-phase health check (HTTP 200 plus client render), marks good boots, isolates or rolls back bad ones, and keeps 3 rotating snapshots. Cross-platform.

items.name: dsh-consumer-audit
items.desc: Audits a DSH profile for capabilities nothing consumes: inventories the declared composition rows, counts how often each registered tool and skill is actually called in the session logs, separates calls that were made from calls that returned a result, and reports the ones with no observed consumer. Ships a skill that fixes the evidence-chain format for completion claims.

items.name: dsh-plugin-capabilities
items.desc: Skills & MCP section in Settings: browse, create, edit and delete skills with live directory watching, toggle loading of any on-disk skill through frontmatter policy keys, register local folders or GitHub repos as extra skill scan roots, edit the MCP server rows in the profile patch, import MCP config from Claude Code or Codex, and install from a curated market of skill repos and MCP servers.

items.name: dsh-noname-kit
items.desc: Noname (Sanguosha-like game) extension workshop. AI writes skill and card extensions behind confirmation gates, static validation and block-based safe writes.

items.name: dsh-malware-audit
items.desc: Real AST-based scan of installed plugins for malicious-intent patterns (dynamic eval, cross-plugin writes, exfiltration-shaped network calls), with an optional periodic schedule and auto-quarantine on critical findings.

items.name: dsh-minimal-anchor
items.desc: Prunes the tool schema to a whitelist and injects a structural preamble on a session's first turn only, then passes every later turn through untouched.

items.name: dsh-wrapped
items.desc: Registers /wrapped, which reads the session's own stats and renders a shareable dark SVG summary card — tool vs. thinking time, decode speed, and a tool/thinking-ratio verdict.

items.name: dsh-pwa-plugin
items.desc: PWA plugin for DSH — adds offline support, service worker caching, and install-as-app capability.

items.name: dsh-auto-observe
items.desc: Records the version of the edit target as an observation when the agent inspected the file with bash instead of the read tool, so the filesystem observation policy stops rejecting edits with FS_NOT_OBSERVED. Applies to edits only; blind whole-file overwrites stay guarded.

items.name: dsh-bash-env
items.desc: Replaces the built-in bash executor so every command gets an environment resolved from its own working directory: configurable PATH prepends, Python venv activation and mise shims, with a dedicated section in the Web UI settings.

items.name: dsh-mcp-mini-manager
items.desc: MCP manager for DeepSeek Harness Web: a Settings page beside Plugins that lists the MCP servers the running loader tree actually holds, each with its config summary, endpoint and live state, and disables or restores any of them through a paired-marker block in the profile's cordis.patch.yml. Env values, header values and `!!js` sources reach the page only as key names or dot-paths.

items.name: dsh-plugin-runcat-inventory
items.desc: Plugin inventory manager for DeepSeek Harness Web: table view of installed plugins with status filters, enable/disable switches applied via HMR, config viewer/copy, uninstall and npm update reminders.

items.name: dsh-skill-mini-manager
items.desc: Skill manager page in the DSH Web Settings panel, at the same level as Plugins: lists every skill the installation serves with its own summary, source and disk footprint, and removes any of them into a recoverable trash.

items.name: dsh-a2a
items.desc: Agent2Agent protocol v1.0 for DSH: run a standard A2A server to let other agents call this instance, connect to remote A2A agents as clients, and manage both from a visual settings page.

items.name: dsh-plugin-resolver
items.desc: Agent-facing plugin installer that resolves DSH-compatible versions, handles ambiguous names, and verifies the loader entry after install.

items.name: pbfuzz#dsh-kanalyzer
items.desc: LLVM static-analysis plugin that builds whole-program bitcode for C/C++ projects and runs kernel-analyzer (KAMain) reachability analysis on it, providing kanalyzer_* tools to the agent and a ctx.kanalyzer service to other plugins.

items.name: dsh-plugin-backup
items.desc: Category-based backup of DeepSeek Harness settings, skills, plugins, sessions and storages into verifiable, restorable and downloadable archives, with optional GitHub sync.

items.name: dsh-spring-boot-launcher
items.desc: Launch and manage local Maven-based Spring Boot applications on Windows, with service controls and searchable logs in the DSH web interface.

items.name: dsh-updater-npm
items.desc: DSH updater + official docs sync in Settings: one-click npm update of @deepseek-ai/dsh with live progress (npm output stream, elapsed timer, monotonic bar), multi-copy protection that only touches the running instance, source-tree mode via git pull, one-click PowerShell 7 install on Windows, incremental sync of the official docs/ with progress, and the dsh_docs_search / dsh_docs_read model tools.

items.name: dsh-plugin-android-preview
items.desc: Windows-only DSH sidebar preview and Dart hot reload for configured Starcompanion / Operit2-derived projects; requires the project preview scripts, a prebuilt debug APK, Android SDK, Flutter and scrcpy 3.3.3.

items.name: dsh-code-coverage
items.desc: Parses DSH session logs to attribute AI-written files, overlays c8 coverage, and reports AI vs human code coverage with a trust score, plus a check/fix/verify tool loop for closing test gaps.

items.name: dsh-plugin-topology
items.desc: Dependency graph inspector for DeepSeek Harness: snapshots the live Cordis plugin/service topology into a zoomable browser panel with graph-theory metrics, plus a graph.render tool for the model.

items.name: dsh-plugin-cicd
items.desc: Bring a DSH plugin repository's build and release pipeline into the app: a sidebar panel listing each repository's latest workflow run, its releases, and how far the local checkout has drifted from the last release, with buttons to trigger a build, cut a release, publish a draft, re-run, cancel, or read the failed-step log. Drives the workflows through the machine's authenticated gh CLI, so the plugin stores no credential of its own, and which repositories are tracked lives in a config file rather than the package.

items.name: dsh-environment-tray
items.desc: Manage environment variables, .env files, and credentials in DeepSeek Harness, including Windows user and system environment variables.

items.name: dsh-provider-proxy
items.desc: Provider-scoped HTTP/HTTPS forward proxy for DeepSeek Harness: configure independent proxy URLs and enable/disable switches per LLM provider, with environment-variable references for proxy credentials and model discovery routing.

items.name: dsh-version-update
items.desc: Version management for dsh: inspect the installed version against every npm channel or version line, install or downgrade in one click, stream the install log live (rollback-snapshot copy progress, npm extraction progress, elapsed time), roll back instantly from local snapshots, and automate the cycle with a policy engine (silent auto-update, execution windows, daily checks). Never stops npm mid-install — a wedged run is only stopped after an hour, and a half-committed global tree is detected and repaired from the pre-install snapshot automatically. Confirms before installing a found update, auto-restarts the host after install, and falls back to a mirror when the primary registry is unreachable.

items.name: dsh-code-review-graph
items.desc: Graph-based code context, impact analysis, review workflows, interactive graphs, and permission-controlled refactoring for DSH using the code-review-graph engine.

items.name: dsh-taptap-maker-dev
items.desc: TapTap Maker game-dev workbench with 150+ bundled skills, custom image lane, ChatGPT web with account rotation, CC0 SFX, web BGM, and a forced no-Maker-credit-burn policy.

items.name: instant-games-open-mcp#packages/dsh-maker
items.desc: TapTap Maker integration for DeepSeek Harness: bundled MCP tools, Maker workflow and feature skills, plus a packaged CLI path for project initialization and diagnostics.

items.name: dsh-healthcheck
items.desc: Read-only DSH environment health check: disk, memory, latency, ~/.dsh bloat and outdated-plugin detection with graded reports and baseline trend comparison. Deletes nothing.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-langfuse
items.desc: Send dsh turn traces, LLM generations, tool spans, and subagent activity to Langfuse.

items.name: dsh-hermes-link#dsh-hermes-link
items.desc: Bidirectional Hermes ↔ DSH bridge: import Hermes sessions into DSH, consult Hermes, and receive Hermes-dispatched tasks as a single Cordis plugin.

items.name: dsh-conflict-doctor
items.desc: Conflict diagnosis and repair for DeepSeek Harness plugins. Builds a capability graph of the running Loader profile and of the on-disk cordis.patch.yml layers, comparing imports, peer ranges and config against the host that is ACTUALLY running rather than the profile's possibly-stale copies, and reports the conflicts that fail silently: a fiber stuck PENDING on a service no plugin provides, a browser half injecting a client module nothing provides, a tool id two plugins both register, duplicate Loader entry ids, a row disabled by one layer and re-inserted by another, an import of a host subpath the running host does not export, and a cycle among inject declarations. Every finding carries its evidence, a confidence grade for who owns a name, and a repair with a risk grade — verify it with a dry-run difference table, or take the individual .patch.yml files that --fix-out writes (never auto-loaded, so picking wrong breaks nothing).

items.name: dsh-rtk
items.desc: Routes eligible bash commands through rtk (Rust Token Killer) so tool output is compressed before it reaches the model, by asking the installed rtk to rewrite each command and adopting what it prints; when rtk is absent the executor behaves exactly like the stock one.

items.name: wangtie-os
items.desc: Fullscreen business-app framework for DeepSeek Harness Web with a dark-sidebar workbench bundling a database connectivity tester and SQL query panel, a two-level knowledge base (bill and accounting) with local search and Word document ingestion, metadata environment comparison with alter-SQL generation, a data dictionary, agent log-search report demos, a system test-case runner, Evernote-style notes, developer utilities, and mini-games.

items.name: dsh-profile-sync
items.desc: Moves a plugin set between DSH profiles (web to desktop by default): diff, pre-checks, an offline script for CLI-owned profiles, and a post-restart verification. It installs nothing itself.

items.desc: FDE toolbox bundle: installing this one plugin pulls in a curated set of common dsh plugins (git server, WebDAV mount, knowledge base, scheduled tasks, auto-resume, UI tweaks, auto-retrospection, file manager, smart titles, task board, plugin market, context trimmer, IM bridge, sidebar enhancements), with a panel showing install status and one-click gap-filling.

items.name: dsh-sync
items.desc: Multi-machine sync: keeps multiple dsh replicas consistent through one private GitCode repository — skills, sessions, settings and plugin manifests each with an independent switch; changes go through branch, PR and merge, remote-only additions are pulled back before every push so nothing is deleted, and an AI smart-align step semantically merges files both sides changed (plus one-click conflict resolution); private repos enforced, pull never overwrites local edits.

items.name: pi2dsh
items.desc: Pi Host ABI compatibility engine: after one install, unmodified Pi extensions from npm mount as native DSH plugins with `dsh plugin add <pi-package>`. Verified end to end on stock DSH with pi-mcp-adapter (full MCP manager: OAuth, resources, prompts, MCP Apps, elicitation, sampling), @tintinweb/pi-subagents, pi-code, pi-hermes-memory and pi-background-tasks; `pi2dsh inspect` reports a package's compatibility before installing.

items.name: dsh-line-pool#dsh-line-pool
items.desc: Outbound route pool for DeepSeek Harness. Ships 15 seed routes plus a 20-entry candidate pool covering 7 target kinds (GitHub raw/codeload/main, npm registry, PyPI index, HuggingFace, general). Routes are verified before use: upstream IP lists go through a TLS handshake with full certificate-chain validation (a bare TCP check can be answered locally and report dead IPs as healthy), and failures advance a cooldown ladder of 2/5/15 minutes with the fastest healthy route picked per target kind. Routes are applied by rewriting the URL with one of four rules (prefix, registry, index, host-replace), reaching git, pip, npm, pnpm, gh, curl and wget through three paths: the shell seam (download commands the model runs through the bash tool are intercepted and rewritten automatically; commands wrapped by the pwsh tool, and fetches made by the host itself or the renderer, are not covered), two registered tools the model can call directly (line_pool_status, line_pool_run), and child-process spawn. Multi-line commands keep their line breaks and only the download segment is touched. URLs carrying credentials (user:token@host) are never rewritten, so tokens are not forwarded to third-party mirrors. No global config is modified. A sidebar panel lists every route with latency, failure reason and cooldown countdown, supports per-route retest and enable/disable, and shows live TUN/proxy status from network-adapter and loopback port checks. The candidate pool is re-verified every 24 hours so newly usable routes are added and dead ones dropped. 570 tests, 87% line coverage.

items.name: dsh-web-service-manager
items.desc: Manage the DSH web service from a settings panel: status, version, restart, stop, and one-click updates.

items.name: dsh-mac-keep-awake
items.desc: macOS only: holds a PreventUserIdleSystemSleep assertion (caffeinate -i -w <host pid>) while any DSH session runs, and releases it when the last one stops, so a long turn is not cut off by idle sleep. The display may still turn off. It keeps holding through the maintenance phase, where Agent.status reports idle and a long manual /compact runs, via the compaction/start and compaction/end events. It reconciles against ctx.agents.list() every 60s, so a session already running when the plugin is hot-reloaded is picked up at once instead of at the next turn boundary. A failed hold retries with exponential backoff capped at 60s and never gives up; release escalates from SIGTERM to SIGKILL after 2s, and -w lets caffeinate exit by itself if the host dies. No browser half — configured through the profile patch. 51 tests, including two that read pmset -g assertions on real hardware.

items.name: dsh-plugin-noema
items.desc: Shows per-turn changes in cyclomatic complexity, cognitive complexity, and maximum nesting depth for TypeScript, Python, and Go in the Web UI, with expandable file and function summaries for code review.

items.name: custom-first-control-prompt
items.desc: Inject deployment-configured system-prompt sections and reference exchanges into every conversation request via stream interception, with a web settings panel.

items.name: dsh-az
items.desc: Azure resource management: query and show resources, deploy Bicep/ARM templates, and check the activity log.

items.name: dsh-codex
items.desc: OpenAI Codex CLI wrapper: one-shot exec, repo review and session resume with a default read-only sandbox.

items.name: dsh-k6
items.desc: Load testing with Grafana k6: smoke-test first, then run scripts and read percentiles from the JSON summary.

items.name: dsh-kubectl
items.desc: Kubernetes ops for the agent: get resources with structured JSON output, describe, logs, exec, apply/delete (user-confirmed) and port-forward.

items.name: dsh-maf
items.desc: Microsoft Agent Framework (MAF) plugin for DeepSeek Harness: validate, run, and scaffold declarative agents and workflows (YAML).

items.name: dsh-terraform
items.desc: Infrastructure as code: gated plan/apply, state and output inspection, and configuration validation via the terraform CLI.

items.name: dsh-winget
items.desc: Windows Package Manager: search, install, upgrade, uninstall, import/export and pin software through native tools.

items.name: dsh-wsl
items.desc: WSL (Windows Subsystem for Linux) bridge for DeepSeek Harness: run Linux commands, manage distros, convert paths, and copy across the Windows/Linux boundary.

items.name: dsh-quickref
items.desc: Developer quick-reference toolbox for DSH: 12 themed categories (195 entries) plus zero-dependency tools — regex tester, JSON formatter, timestamp converter, Base64/URL codec, cron generator and line diff, in a searchable settings panel.

items.name: dsh-llm-trace
items.desc: Wire-level LLM inspector: captures the raw HTTP request and response bodies of model provider calls and attributes each capture to the session that caused it through the llm/stream waterfall. The request pane renders the body as a collapsible tree with per-node sizes — one measured request was 98.6% a single 973-entry array — and the response pane reassembles the OpenAI-style SSE chunk stream into reasoning, content, tool calls and usage. Shown in a Conversation View tab and a loopback viewer page.

items.name: dsh-advisor
items.desc: Automatic second-opinion review: a restricted child session re-reads the agent's recent work with read-only tools and delivers at most one evidence-backed note, or stays silent. Requires a model route in the config; the plugin stays disabled until one is set.

items.name: dsh-codebase-watcher
items.desc: Staleness keeper for the Codebase Memory knowledge graph: it compares the graph Branch node head_sha with git rev-parse HEAD and reports an exact behindBy, rebuilds only the stale projects through the codebase-memory-mcp CLI so the MCP tool 60-second cap does not apply, watches each project for edits, and mirrors the same state into a settings card and a REST control surface.

items.name: dsh-port-manager
items.desc: Native DSH right-sidebar tab that lists the ports this machine is listening on together with the process behind each one, and offers per-port actions to open it, copy its address, reveal its working directory or end the process.

items.name: dsh-plugin-selfcheck
items.desc: Prints every plugin in the DeepSeek Harness loader tree at boot, with the exception text for anything that failed, and checks dependency version drift, profile config validity, web port reachability and registered tools.

items.name: dsh-hot-restart
items.desc: One fixed button inside the DSH window that restarts DSH and reopens it automatically, with no console window; right-click it for a built-in self check that writes a single diagnostic report.

items.name: dsh-run-config
items.desc: IDE-style run configurations for DSH: save LLM prompts and shell commands as reusable run configs (global or per-workspace), run them from the session header or the new-session page, and manage them via the task_run_config tool with approval-gated writes.

items.name: dsh-insight-tree
items.desc: Runtime observability and plugin operations panel for DeepSeek Harness: shows the profile plugin tree, real Loader fiber state, capabilities/dependencies/compatibility, current-session plugin activity and upstream source/version checks, with one-click enable/disable/update/uninstall plus a standalone startup-failure diagnostics page that works while DSH is not running.

items.name: dsh-win-pwsh7
items.desc: Reports which PowerShell the DSH pwsh executor rows actually run — enabled rows only, with version-numbered Store paths refused as pins — and installs the self-updating Microsoft Store package as a background job after reading the connection cost, because Windows defers Store downloads on a connection marked as metered. Two tools and a prompt section on the host side, plus a configuration card, a diagnostics section and a re-detect action in the Web UI; Windows only, no runtime dependencies.

items.name: dsh-ballast
items.desc: Context-window attribution for DSH Web: a Mini Utility Dock panel that ranks the user messages, assistant turns, reasoning blocks and tool results of a session by the tokens each one occupies, so it is clear which entries hold the window. It also shows the share by entry type, the heaviest entries across the live sessions of the host, and, where the host provides them, provider usage and the estimated system/tools/messages composition. The panel is read-only: it does not estimate cost, modify a session, or trigger compaction.

items.name: dsh-instance-manager
items.desc: Instance manager for DSH Web: a Mini Utility Dock panel that lists every local dsh web instance the machine can see (port, PID, uptime, live session count, resident memory, version), starts a new instance on an automatically picked free port in 3080-3129 or on a port you name, opens a row in a new tab, and stops one or all of them through that instance’s own graceful shutdown (appExit). Rows also show what each instance is serving, and read-only instance logs and session summaries are one click away. Where a peer is configured, the same panel lists and queries instances on other machines over a bearer-authenticated link. Every route is loopback-guarded, and a browser-facing action must additionally pass the host’s own browser authentication.

items.name: dsh-treekeeper
items.desc: Windows process-tree reconciler for the DSH host: samples the host process tree and the job ledger, attributes each process to the job that created it, flags unattributed and orphaned processes with a confidence level, and offers guarded termination of a whole tree. Termination is refused unless the target belongs to the DSH host tree, is re-sampled and re-checked immediately before the kill (creation time included), and contains no protected descendant, so an allowlisted PID cannot widen the kill scope.

items.name: dsh-eval-control
items.desc: Host-side DSH evaluation control plugin: injects one evaluation trial's variables, budget limits, session root and fork lineage into the agent process, routes its model calls through a host broker under a gateway lease, and writes a schema-versioned bundle descriptor for evidence attribution.

items.name: dsh-perf-hud
items.desc: Client-side performance HUD and always-on recorder for DeepSeek Harness: FPS and worst frame, long tasks with four-leg attribution (React fiber / subtree / DOM writes / scheduler), per-plugin callback rate and sync time, DOM growth and writers, JS heap, host event loop and link RTT, plus a night-watch recorder that keeps the worst stalls and exports incident packs for replay.

items.name: dsh-compose-panel
items.desc: Lists the Docker Compose projects of your DSH workspaces in the right sidebar, one group per project directory, with container status, project- and service-level up/stop/restart, and streamed per-service logs.

items.name: dsh-simple-restart
items.desc: Adds a restart row to Settings → General that relaunches dsh web with the same invocation through a detached helper, refuses under a detected systemd supervisor unless allowRestart is true, and tests whether the listening port is free by connecting to it rather than binding it.

items.name: dsh-routing-suite
items.desc: One repository, three parts: a runtime injector for DSH plugin packages (inject, hot-reload, unload, promote a dev staging tool to the front, route self-heal, plus a settings-page plugin manager that lists, unloads and drags folders in to internalize), a task-aware reasoning-mode router agent preset (router-standard / router-spec / router-react), and a graded two-level task protocol whose six tools (commit_star, lock_stage, revise_do, edit_plan, mark_task, redteam_verdict) pin task state to disk. The injector implementation ships in-tree, so the install carries its own behaviour rather than a dependency list.

items.name: dsh-plugin-compare
items.desc: Compares existing DSH sessions or runs controlled A/B trials between agent presets, showing aligned timelines, paired metric deltas, explicit success checks, and exportable reports.

items.name: dsh-readcache
items.desc: Version-token-validated in-process result cache for the DSH read tool: repeated reads of unchanged files skip file I/O and line rendering, with a readcache tool for stats and clearing.

items.name: dsh-profile-lab
items.desc: Runs reproducible DSH profile and patch experiments with guided case authoring, assertions, Web comparison reports, recovery, and policy gates.

items.name: request-frame-preview
items.desc: Session-header button that previews and downloads the exact request frame DeepSeek Harness sends to the model: the full system prompt, the declared tools array, and the wire message array (system/user/assistant/tool-result) rebuilt from the session log via the same folds the agent loop reads.

items.name: dsh-skills-mcp-manager
items.desc: Skills & MCP manager in the DSH web settings: browse/enable/import/delete skills across project and user roots, and manage stdio/streamable-http MCP servers with a real connection (tools registered as mcp__<server>__<tool>, config in ~/.dsh/mcp.json).

items.name: dsh-plugin-toggle
items.desc: Enables or disables DSH plugins from Settings → Plugins: each toggle stops or starts the plugin immediately without a restart and the change persists across restarts.

items.name: dsh-mega-plugins#dsh-github-issue
items.desc: GitHub issue service for DSH: turns a telemetry failure analysis into a uniform issue report, builds a pre-filled new-issue URL that is shortened when it would exceed a configured length budget, and rewrites a plain description into a structured issue with the deployment's model.

items.name: dsh-mega-plugins#dsh-telemetry
items.desc: Local-only telemetry service for DSH plugins: records operation trails and error events into a storage-domain KV table, redacts configurable secret patterns before the write, and groups one plugin's failures by feature-code anchor, reporting the window it read, the route each group ran on, and the attempts recorded after its last failure.

items.name: dsh-task-effort
items.desc: Auto-adjust model reasoning effort per task (off/low/high/max): task classification, \[effort=...] markers, in-turn error escalation, DeepSeek peak-pricing-period capping with countdown notices, and manual-selection priority.

items.name: dsh-updater
items.desc: Track DeepSeek Harness's own releases and update in one click: reads the npm dist-tags and the GitHub changelog, shows every change between the running build and the target, grades the risk, then hands the install to a detached helper that backs the current install up with an atomic rename, runs npm, verifies what landed, relaunches, and rolls back when the new build does not come up.

items.name: dsh-janitor
items.desc: Registers a janitor_scan tool that returns a deterministic, reviewable cleanup plan for session debris (plan docs, scratch scripts) with per-file verdicts and evidence; scan-only, never deletes.

items.name: dsh-wx-preview
items.desc: Preview native WeChat Mini Programs in the DSH sidebar with a local runtime and WXML source locations.

items.name: dsh-android-emulator-helper
items.desc: Android development toolchain inside DeepSeek Harness: 23 android_* tools that find the SDK, create and manage AVDs, start and stop emulators, scaffold a Kotlin/Compose project, build and run it with Gradle, then install, launch, screenshot, tail logcat and drive the UI. A settings page holds the SDK, emulator, API-level, build and output parameters.

items.name: dsh-ios-simulator-helper
items.desc: The official ZCode ios-simulator plugin ported to native DSH tools: the original 20 ios_* tools keep their names and arguments, plus ios_shutdown_simulator, covering Xcode project discovery and scaffolding, simulator boot and shutdown, build, install, launch and terminate, screenshots, log reading, an in-app settings page and optional idb UI automation. macOS only.

items.name: dsh-time-machine
items.desc: Creates local, content-addressed workspace checkpoints with diff previews and two-phase restore confirmation.

items.name: dsh-ballute
items.desc: Crash protection for installed plugins: crash cards with one-click disable, static pre-flight inspection, black-box crash telemetry, and a safe-mode rescue profile for a broken UI.

items.name: dsh-cn-boot
items.desc: China-network bootstrap for dsh: probes npm/npmmirror/GitHub/HuggingFace/Gitee and local proxies, reads registry config, recommends mirrors/proxy, and generates a PowerShell + bash bootstrap script. Read-only by default; apply is explicit. CLI plus an agent-callable cn_boot tool.

items.name: dsh-dep-audit
items.desc: Dependency supply-chain hygiene audit for dsh projects and profiles: peer-range resolvability, broken dist-tag detection (#2763 class), stale / missing-license / non-registry dependencies, and installed-vs-declared drift — CLI plus an agent-callable dep_audit tool.

items.name: dsh-discussions-radar
items.desc: Official GitHub Discussions radar for DeepSeek Harness: list, filter and search the official boards (Ideas / Q&A / Show Your Plugins! / General / Announcements / Polls) — CLI plus an agent-callable discussions_radar tool, dsh-discussions-radar/v1 reports, zero runtime deps, read-only public API.

items.name: dsh-disk-audit
items.desc: Disk-usage audit for dsh data directories: total size, per-directory breakdown, largest files, oversized-file warnings (session logs can hit hundreds of MB) and cleanup suggestions — CLI plus an agent-callable disk_audit tool, dsh-disk-audit/v1 reports, zero runtime deps, read-only.

items.name: dsh-firstrun
items.desc: First-run health check for DeepSeek Harness: verifies Node/pnpm/dsh toolchain, home, profile, API key (names only, never values), workspace writability and npm registry, then prints actionable next steps — CLI plus an agent-callable quickstart tool, dsh-firstrun/v1 reports, zero runtime deps.

items.name: dsh-llms-forge
items.desc: Generate llms.txt for dsh plugin repositories from package.json + README — AI-readable discovery files, zero runtime deps, read-only by default. CLI plus an agent-callable llms_forge tool.

items.name: dsh-quality-score
items.desc: Plugin quality scorecard for DeepSeek Harness: 0-100 with grade, 6 components, fix suggestions per deduction, batch leaderboard - CLI plus an agent-callable quality_score tool.

items.name: dsh-readme-forge
items.desc: Generate README.md for dsh plugin repositories from package.json + cordis.patch.yml + source layout — install/CLI/tools/dev/license sections, deterministic, zero runtime deps, read-only by default. CLI plus an agent-callable readme_forge tool.

items.name: dsh-timesheet
items.desc: Turn-based time tracking from dsh session logs: totals, per-day/project/provider/source rollups, tool-call counts, failure rates, and time-to-first-token — CLI plus an agent-callable timesheet tool, dsh-timesheet/v1 reports, zero runtime deps.

items.name: dsh-unplug
items.desc: Plug/unplug any DeepSeek Harness plugin cleanly — list every mounted layer (bundles + patch rows), remove with full cleanup, disable/enable without deleting, and audit for orphaned/dangling state. CLI + agent-callable unplug tool. Read-only by default; destructive operations require explicit confirmation.

items.name: dsh-dupguard
items.desc: Stops a streaming model call when the same string repeats ten times in a row (threshold configurable), keeps the partial answer as a normal assistant message, and shows a stop notice with the workspace, session name and the repeated string. Repeat counts can vary by unit length through a piecewise table or a JavaScript module, and code regions (fenced, inline, indented) use a relaxed threshold.

items.name: dsh-upgrade-guard
items.desc: Audits installed plugin compatibility after a DeepSeek Harness upgrade, repairs or disables incompatible plugins, and keeps an out-of-host supervisor that rescues boot failures or rolls back to the previous host snapshot.
